# Progress monitoring cycle2

We want to track the progress of monitoring cycle 2 of MHQ for the terrestrial habitat types. 

To do this we use we compare (1) the original sample for MHQ cycle 2 (`mhq_terr_sample_c2`) with
(2) the standardized tables of the assessments and measurements.

The assessments table also contains assessment for monitoring cycle 1. 
We can identify the assessments for monitoring cycle 2, based on the start year of monitoring cycle 2.
The start year is different per type, and is documented in the table `mhq_terr_moncycle.csv`.
See table below.

```{r, message = FALSE}
path <- fileman_up("n2khab-mhq-design")

mhq_terr_sample <- read_vc("mhq_terr_sample_c2",
                           file.path(path, "mhq_terr_cycle2/output")) %>%
    mutate(main_type = as.character(main_type),
           date_assessment_c1 = as.Date(date_assessment_c1))

mhq_terr_relocations <- read_vc("mhq_terr_relocations_c2",
                           file.path(path, "mhq_terr_cycle2/output"))

mhq_terr_moncycle <- read_csv2(file.path(path, "overzicht_mhq/data/mhq_terr_moncycle.csv"),
                               col_types =  "ciii")
```

```{r}

path_mhq_terr <- "../../data/mhq_terr/v2026"

mhq_terr_assessments <- read_vc("mhq_terr_assessments", 
                                root = path_mhq_terr)

mhq_terr_refpoints <- read_vc("mhq_terr_refpoints", 
                                root = path_mhq_terr) 
    
mhq_terr_measurements <- read_vc("mhq_terr_measurements", 
                                root = path_mhq_terr)

val <- read_vc("mhq_terr_measurements_validation", 
                                root = "../../data/mhq_terr/")

```


```{r}
mhq_terr_moncycle %>%
    datatable(rownames = FALSE,
              filter = "top")
```

## Check mhq_terr_sample

First we check of the coordinates of the sampling units in mhq_terr_sample correspond with those in mhq_terr_refpoints.

```{r}
check_coords_sample <- mhq_terr_sample %>%
    left_join(mhq_terr_refpoints %>%
                  select(point_code, x_ref = x, y_ref = y, grts_ranking_refpoint = grts_ranking),
              by = "point_code") %>%
    mutate(distance = sqrt((x - x_ref) ^ 2 + (y - y_ref) ^ 2) %>%
               round(2)) %>%
    filter(distance > 1) %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 31370, remove = FALSE)

grts_master <- read_GRTSmh()

check_coords_sample <- check_coords_sample %>%
    mutate(grts_check = (terra::extract(grts_master,check_coords_sample))$GRTSmaster_habitats) %>%
    st_drop_geometry()
```

In the table below the coordinates in mhq_terr_refpoint (x_ref, y_ref) are different.

```{r}
check_coords_sample  %>%
    select(point_code, type, reassessment, x, y, x_ref, y_ref, grts_ranking_refpoint, distance, grts_check) %>%
    datatable(rownames = FALSE,
              filter = "top")
```

Interpretation: 

+ 435377_2 coordinates are incorrect in mhq_terr_sample, should be 435377_1
+ 528582_1 should be 528582_2 in mhq_terr_sample
+ 2358709_1 in mhq_terr_refpoints is the legacy site bd_10 (but never assessed for mhq), in mhq_terr_sample it corresponds with the grid centroid --> let 's change mhq_terr_refpoints
+ 3741830_2 should be corrected in mhq_terr_sample
+ 3740849_2: ask Patrik: are the coordinates in INBOVEG correct (the RTK ones)?

```{r}
mhq_terr_sample_corrected <- check_coords_sample %>%
    mutate(point_code = ifelse(point_code == "435377_2", "435377_1", point_code),
           point_code = ifelse(point_code == "528582_1", "528582_2", point_code),
           x = ifelse(point_code == "3741830_2", x_ref , x),
           y = ifelse(point_code == "3741830_2", y_ref , y)) %>%
    select(colnames(mhq_terr_sample))

mhq_terr_sample_update <- mhq_terr_sample %>%
    anti_join(check_coords_sample, by = c("point_code", "type")) %>%
    bind_rows(mhq_terr_sample_corrected)

check <- nrow(mhq_terr_sample_update) == nrow(mhq_terr_sample)

# mhq_terr_refpoints aanpassen

coords_2358709_1 <- check_coords_sample %>%
    filter(point_code == "2358709_1")

mhq_terr_refpoints <- mhq_terr_refpoints %>%
    mutate(x = ifelse(point_code == "2358709_1", coords_2358709_1$x, x),
           y = ifelse(point_code == "2358709_1", coords_2358709_1$y, y),
           grts_ranking = ifelse(point_code == "2358709_1", coords_2358709_1$grts_check, grts_ranking))

mhq_terr_refpoints %>%
    write_vc(root = "../../data/mhq_terr/v2026", 
             file = "mhq_terr_refpoints",
             sorting = "point_code",
             digits = 20,
             strict = FALSE)
```

We also check if date_assessment_c1 in mhq_terr_sample corresponds with an actual measurement in mhq_terr_measurements.
This is not the case for following records:

```{r}
measurements_c1 <- mhq_terr_measurements %>%
    select(point_code, measurement_date, type, user_reference, fieldwork_team) %>%
    left_join(val %>%
                  select(point_code, valid_sampling_unit, valid_refpoint),
              by = "point_code")

check_reassessments <- mhq_terr_sample_update %>%
    filter(reassessment) %>%
    left_join(measurements_c1, by = c("point_code", "type", "date_assessment_c1" = "measurement_date")) %>%
    left_join(mhq_terr_assessments %>%
                  select(point_code, assessment_date, type_observed = type, is_present),
              by = c("point_code", "date_assessment_c1" = "assessment_date")) %>%
    filter(is.na(fieldwork_team)) %>%
    group_by(point_code) %>%
    filter(!(n() > 1 & type != type_observed)) %>%
    ungroup()
```

```{r}
check_reassessments %>%
    select(panel, point_code, type,  date_assessment_c1, type_observed, is_present) %>%
    datatable(rownames = FALSE, 
              filter = "top")
```
+ Case 1: wrong date in mhq_terr_sample --> change date in mhq_terr_sample

```{r}

case_1 <- check_reassessments %>%
    filter(is.na(type_observed)) %>%
    left_join(measurements_c1, by = c("point_code", "type")) 

case_1 %>%
    select(panel, point_code, type,  date_assessment_c1, measurement_date) %>%
    datatable(rownames = FALSE, 
              filter = "top")

case_1_corrected <- case_1 %>%
    mutate(date_assessment_c1 = measurement_date) %>%
    select(colnames(mhq_terr_sample))
```
+ Case 2:
    + sampling units that were assessed but where type is not present
    + the sampling units were relocated (point_code measured)
    + most of the relocations are not valid --> remove from mhq_terr_sample when not yet assessed in cycle2

```{r}

measurements_c1 <- measurements_c1 %>%
    separate_wider_delim(cols = point_code,
                        delim = "_",
                        names = c("prefix", "suffix"),
                        cols_remove = FALSE)

case_2 <- check_reassessments %>%
    filter(type_observed == type, !is_present) %>%
    separate_wider_delim(cols = point_code,
                         delim = "_",
                         names = c("prefix", "suffix"),
                         cols_remove = FALSE) %>%
    select(-valid_sampling_unit, -valid_refpoint) %>%
    left_join(measurements_c1 %>%
                  select(point_code_measured = point_code, prefix, type, date_assessment_c1 = measurement_date, valid_sampling_unit, valid_refpoint),
              by = c("prefix", "type", "date_assessment_c1")
            )

case_2 %>%
    select(point_code, date_assessment_c1, type, is_present, point_code_measured, valid_sampling_unit, valid_refpoint) %>%
    datatable(rownames = FALSE,
              filter = "top")
```

```{r}
case_2_remove <- case_2 %>%
    filter(!valid_sampling_unit)

mhq_terr_sample_remove <- mhq_terr_sample %>%
    semi_join(case_2_remove, by = "point_code")

case_2_corrected <- case_2 %>%
    filter(valid_sampling_unit | is.na(valid_sampling_unit)) %>%
    mutate(point_code = point_code_measured) %>%
    select(-x, -y) %>%
    left_join(mhq_terr_refpoints %>%
                  select(point_code, x, y),
              by = "point_code") %>%
    select(colnames(mhq_terr_sample))
```

+ case 3: type observed in assessment is different from type
    + 3069105_1: is OK (2190_overig and is_present = FALSE does not conflict with type = 2190_mp)
    + 4346754_1: 6510_hu instead of 6510_huk, no oversampling needed for 6510 --> remove sampling unit

```{r}
case_3 <- check_reassessments %>%
    anti_join(case_1, by = "point_code") %>%
    anti_join(case_2, by = "point_code")

case_3 %>%
    select(point_code, date_assessment_c1, oversampling_subtype, type, type_observed, is_present) %>%
    datatable(rownames = FALSE,
              filter = "top")
```
```{r}
case_3_remove <- case_3 %>%
    filter(point_code == "4346754_1")
```


## Check Relocation

We also have to take the relocations into account. 
We have to link the measurements in the relocated sampling units with the original sampling unit in mhq_terr_sample_c2.
This can be done with the function `detect_relocations`.

```{r}



```

```{r}

relocations <- detect_relocations()

start_c2 <- mhq_terr_moncycle %>%
    filter(mon_cycle == 2) %>%
    select(main_type, mon_cycle, year_start)

assessments_c2 <- mhq_terr_assessments %>%
    anti_join(relocations, by = c("point_code", "assessment_date")) %>%
    bind_rows(relocations %>%
                  mutate(change_location = TRUE)) %>%
    inner_join(mhq_terr_sample %>%
                  select(point_code, type_target_c2 = type),
              by = "point_code") %>%
    mutate(main_type_target_c2 = str_sub(type_target_c2, 1, 4)) %>%
    left_join(start_c2, by = c("main_type_target_c2" = "main_type")) %>%
    filter(year(assessment_date) >= year_start) %>%
    mutate(point_code_measured = ifelse(is.na(point_code_relocation), point_code, point_code_relocation))

measurements_c2 <- mhq_terr_measurements %>%
    semi_join(assessments_c2, by = c("point_code", "measurement_date" = "assessment_date"))

nrow(assessments_su_orig) == nrow(mhq_terr_assessments)
 
check <- mhq_terr_assessments %>%
    anti_join(assessments_su_orig, by = c("point_code", "assessment_date"))
 


progress_c2 <- mhq_terr_sample %>%
    rename(type_target = type, main_type_target = main_type) %>%
    left_join(assessments_su_orig, by = "point_code") %>%
    filter(year(assessment_date) >= year_start | is.na(assessment_date)) #opname 2de cyclus of nog niet opgemeten

nrow(progress_c2) == nrow(mhq_terr_sample)
```
